concerns.text: FR-001 and FR-002 mandate generating graph objects and feature vectors for *every* document. Tasks T016a and T016b are marked incomplete (checkbox unchecked), meaning the deliverable for the core US1 requirement is missing. This is a silent relaxation of the spec's output requirement.

FR-004 requires simulating retrieval ranking and extracting topological signatures from retrieved documents. Tasks T022 (ranking) and T023 (signature extraction) are incomplete. Without these, the comparison between graph-based and neural-based retrieval (US2) cannot be executed, violating the spec's core hypothesis test.

FR-005 and FR-006 require Spearman correlation and paired t-tests to validate the hypothesis. Tasks T029a/b, T031, and T032 are incomplete. This leaves the Success Criteria (SC-001, SC-003, SC-005) untestable, effectively weakening the requirement to 'measure' to 'attempt to measure'.

FR-007 mandates enforcing a strict 6-hour time budget (N * 60s <= 6h). Task T008b (timer implementation) is incomplete. Without this enforcement mechanism, the CI constraint is not preserved in the task list, risking pipeline failure or silent timeout violations.

The spec's Edge Cases require handling documents with <5 unique terms. While T010 (unit test) is complete, T011 (integration test) is incomplete. The acceptance criterion for 'pipeline does not crash' on low-diversity docs is not verified in the task list, weakening the robustness requirement.

SC-004 requires measuring computational resource usage (RAM) against CI constraints. Task T030 only mentions calculating 'wall-clock time' and 'latency reduction'. There is no task to log or verify peak RAM usage (7GB limit), silently dropping the RAM constraint from the verification steps.
